2026-10-24 工作日志

当日回看

  • 低精度的四条路径不能互证：VeOmni路线核#8342已有作者原型/后端讨论前置，#8330已合并的只是梯度RS接线；计算、参数AG、梯度RS与rollout格式分开。torchao0.18标准rowwise/float8 AG受限；作者通信微基准收益不能替代actor整步，最终树也不能借旧GPU报告验收。本轮仅资料/源码，不新增竞争方案或硬件队列。

  • 种子输入与采样保证分层：UniRL AR入口核#474已合并、#507报告者仍自做；当前SGLang显式seed需确定性路径，n1不等于组fanout变1，Omni diffusion种子不能替代AR接线。原生Sample/原完整解析模块六组CPU控制，非RNG/模型或多副本复现验收；条件补原M5参考，不改方案/开训练。

  • 率稳定也可能丢了计数：#8341计数增量将三个spec计数跨resume相加；新增2原测试体旧单次过/续跑失败、新均过。原统计函数对旧末段与新总数给相同比率，不等于计数完整；attempt/request/turn语义仍需实际producer核对，非推测解码或性能实测，原M5参考已更新。

  • 新版可能收窄保证而非只加测试：#8348当前head删除旧配置测试及冲突/镜像/PP/动态CP guard，撤回FSDP entropy改动；两版五组真实OmegaConf输入确认旧拒绝组合现接受。旧19项通过仅属旧head，不证明新版并行支持；未运行worker/指标或collective，原M5参考已更新，不另修复或排训练。

  • 控制门须对应真实通信边界：UniRL #494源码区分source/chunk门，但raw项内packed MoE仍可逐expert DTensor重分布，不能据末端标记或单进程替身判“挡住全部collective”。14次静态检查，不是死锁复现/通信或显存验收；超时排序与del也不等于回滚/物理释放。条件补M5原参考，不开发竞争方案。

  • 已有功能验证不能漏记，也不能当内容认证：#8252旧评估已改正无回应/无验证概括；维护者指向真实同步后的logprob对照。原metric/判定CPU控制中，1/1000 token残差1仍低于k3均值门槛，多轮退出只判末轮；不是同步故障或模型实测。独立参考+破坏/恢复是另一保证，原M5条件参考不变，不另实现checker或重开#8250。

  • 小权重不保证小优势：监控奖励目标隔离原解析/原生Part CPU控制中，主奖励同分时1e-6探针经标准化得到约±0.9597；同例1e-9又因FP32舍入归零，不能泛化。零权重只隔离weighted_sum数值，探针缺失/NaN仍标失败；monitor需求已派GoDiao，不另写实现，非服务/模型或训练验收，无新硬件任务。

  • 无错误退出不代表配方稳定：LTX2音频奖励证据读#475全部后续评论，社区同head晚期退化不能被旧正文曲线覆盖；当前训练10/评估30步与正文4步分开，音频policy权重不自动调整KL。仅raw YAML/源码静态核对，不是本机复训或质量判断；反证记M5原参考，不启配方/另调稳定器。

  • 补齐数量与计分成员分开：UniRL评估尾批核#464原Sample树/聚合片段；pad仍生成评分但均值只收真实叶子，roots×fanout数量guard不保证保序。helper可保多层树不代表PE允许多输入Part，短集合与AR DP补齐规则不同；非完整eval/真实评分或DP验收，条件记M5原参考，不另写修复或启评估。

  • 卸载保存对象由checkpoint边界决定：UniRL激活卸载原回调接真实CPU autograd八组：仅offload会保存参数/输入/中间值，叠checkpoint本例仅输入；dtype保持、stride可变，参数身份/state key不变。非设备传输/显存或FSDP/EP验收，不能把元素计数变成容量收益；真机条件补M5原参考，不自动启flag或排训练。

  • step标签不是训练步存储协议：verl gauge后续核新#8357与#8315重叠；原logger→固定SDK emit/push四分支控制，前者保留原名/字符串step标签，后者metric_log输出整数global_step trace。捕获sink不认证服务/存储；若标签直接作维度则每步新组合，不另写修复、部署监控或排GPU任务。

  • 计算分片不等于驻留分片或通用恢复：视频VAE状态协商核#469仍draft且依赖fork的H3 SP；三项静态AST保持内层算法，公开hook/slicing未复制，汇总后全rank仍持有视频。非解码/collective/性能验收；真机条件补原M5参考，不新增必跑任务或开发并行SP方案。

  • 零步控制不是充分认证：UniRL离线DPO原归约与后半数学片段CPU检查：正确配对/跨prompt重排均可log2且accuracy0，策略梯度仍非零；偶数布局、语义配对与参考身份分开。非完整算法、模型或CUDA确定性验收，不另起修复/新M5任务。

  • 参考图数不是样本数：UniRL多参考容器原CPU容器3行5图保持owner/像素形状/metadata，重复选整行保留别名，稠密槽拒绝混合图数；legacy两图默认归两行而非一行双参考。非Part/fork或模型/训练验收，已有作者不另起修复/硬件队列；#562仅核新merge及AR blob相同，不重跑旧验证。

  • 加严共享校验也可能破坏合法模式：UniRL prompt契约核#497仍open但维护者已反对按现状合入；合法无文本音视频请求在三版选择方法对照中仅被候选拒绝，ImageBind默认模式与调用顺序为源码证据，非模型回归。缺失/空串/长度不齐分开，不另演化修复或新增M5任务。

  • 比较计时前先补齐同一工作：UniRL原生配置报告复算公开五行，完整训练+0.782%，错配actor-only会变成+33.672%；prompt选取哈希匹配，但不是实际资产或运行验收。不同物理节点/精度/执行路径不作质量或统计等价，未跑性能/设备或新增M5任务。

  • 内部版本常量与消息身份分开：UniRL Pipe学习八组原runtime真实spawn/Pipe控制，严格连续整数ID/非空command仍保留；合法信封不等于可执行命令，其他HTTP/IPC版本未删除。#568明确未修#567，H20阻塞不解除；非完整引擎/设备验收，无新M5任务。

  • 引用布局不等于张量接口：UniRL逐行索引后续复现#589两步修复的不同作用，三版×三布局控制；最终只读三个索引、保留latent handles，原Segment拼接不读payload，显式hydrate后数值一致。CPU handle/前沿为夹具，非Ray/远端或模型验收；#563核心统计AST迁移保持，不重复旧数值实验，无新M5任务。

  • 反向资格不等于统计资格：UniRL空响应后续核#598合并main后的新guard；两版六输入原方法控制，父提交全空/混合抛KeyError、新head六项通过。全空偏差0是无有效观测，不是anchor一致性实测；非算法/训练/通信验收，旧GPU证据不迁移，无新M5任务或重复修复。

  • Parity需绑定联合版本与配置：UniRL分拆尽调确认#430拆#504/#505、同作者已有实现；原/分拆vLLM与缓存开关不混用，selected-token精确前向不等于梯度/optimizer或任意栈保证。无本机parity/设备执行，不重复实现或新排M5任务。

  • Judge零分不能反推明确判错或失败已过滤：回复协议原方法七组本地Response控制通过，观察关键词否定/长回复边界、未识别不重试、空choices/503重试归零；success=True仅源码接线。非真实judge/超时/奖励栈或训练验收，不擅改协议、发上游或新增M5任务。

  • 旧TP1报告、已合并HTTP同步和未合并通用placement分开：UniRL TP后续核#222因后续取代关闭、#226已合并限定范围、#318关闭未合并；不把旧限制当当前事实，也不把作者历史H20实测搬成本机/当前head验收。无重复TP补丁或新增M5任务。

  • 标题不是需求，方向认可不是验收或本机授权：UniRL需求边界核#433正文null、#416维护者已邀原提议者做可选judge文档/配置；不自行改CI或抢写provider，也不发送prompt/API key或调用付费endpoint。无代码/设备执行，不新增M5任务。

  • key覆盖、可读性和编码器身份分开：UniRL离线embedding原store真实CPU文件控制两次一致：3 prompt/2片读回，缺片coverage过/get拒绝；resume核字符串而非权重内容，单次rename失败后旧index保持、新resume可恢复。非模型编码、共享存储/断电或训练验收，不新增M5任务。

  • RFC未关不等于功能未合入：UniRL分项覆盖确认#450的#513、#537的#548/#549/#550均merged；只覆盖H3缓存及限定BAGEL路径，非整个RFC/所有算法或本机验收。不重复实现，也不将剩余路线自动认领；无新M5任务。

  • 续跑下限也按整条响应累计：verl续跑长度核#8356；原四测试协程隔离执行，base三断言失败、head四通过，下限不重置、不补缺失值。非完整pytest/追踪/Ray/真实后端或EOS验收，不新增M5任务。

  • 配置默认和更新次数各有现成推进者：verl资源与调度尽调确认#7398已有同报告者#8340、旧#7525关闭未合并；#8099已有下游实现/原型，固定次数、UID分组和分母契约不可混为完整覆盖。未执行Ray/TQ/训练或复跑作者测试，不另起竞争补丁/新硬件任务。

  • 测试隔离不等于容量或设备保证：verl缓存与临时目录核#8343的输出路径、pytest根和配置锁声明；两项原路径赋值/真实pytest CPU控制通过，非原引擎、HF保存、真实只读挂载或配额故障复现。锁消费者不在verl Python中，不能以YAML声明充当适配层验收；不新增M5任务。

  • 防御 guard 不是已证根因，旧关闭评论不是当前状态：verl部分覆盖尽调核#8122/#8125仍未消除原崩溃、#8000当前重开且#8003/#8056分SFT/RL叠加推进；不重复实现或把相关性当因果。无候选代码执行/原测试/设备验收，作者回移GPU结果不搬当前head，不新增M5任务。

  • 失败传播、内容一致和读取终止不是同一保证：UniRL教师边界核#515后续澄清/#575已合并与当前调用链；取消仅尽力、hash在读完后，均不保证卡住读取结束。原指纹函数6组CPU控制、5模块compile，非Ray/Gloo/教师或训练验收；不重复已有修复/新增M5任务。

  • mask 总数正确不等于 response 边界正确：异步奖励补齐原构造/消费片段三组两版本 CPU 对照两次一致；旧末条2误读5、6误读1，head恢复长度但拼接更宽，第二组应有惩罚反而增加。非完整worker/TQ/位置ID/多模态或原pytest验收，无新GPU任务；已有作者不竞争。

00:09 — 核清异步奖励的 prompt response 补齐边界

目的：恢复跨日接续后，按实际updated查询选择此前未覆盖的#8101异步奖励padding问题，核清张量生产/消费边界；不重复已有作者实现。先快进417b963→59c6fb3，保留M5资源与#8313接续，不执行设备操作。

成果：原奖励专题、CPU复查脚本及双向索引。固定head a58b1d2b9bbc465d89910de583f8a30aa7dc917e、base/祖先8718ca30a3f002f93b7c4fd99b9b2506718681bc，ahead1/behind0，3文件229增4删；读取OPEN/API draft=false，但作者正文仍保留待人工亲自复跑说明，元数据不替代验收。不是我方PR，不修改上游。

本机复现两次：

HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 /private/tmp/verl-8281-venv/bin/python -B experiments/scripts/verify_verl_reward_padding.py /Users/jackiemac/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/new-chat/work/verl-7913

Python3.12.13、torch2.14.1、Transformers5.20.2、tokenizers0.23.3，复用现有环境，无安装/下载。真实本地WordLevel/PreTrainedTokenizerFast（token0普通LEAK、pad3），原_pad_token_ids完整helper、构造循环选中语句及4个原pad_sequence表达式，DAPO原长度切片4赋值与原惩罚分支；SimpleNamespace只供属性，不是运行worker/manager。三组两版本结果两次一致：(3,5)/(9,2)末条旧推5→head2，旧解码3个LEAK、penalty -0.5→0、宽11→14；(10,2)/(1,6)旧推1→head6，penalty0→-0.75、宽12→16；等长控制均2、宽5。head断言input_ids与cat(prompts,responses)一致。恢复真实长度不保证reward升高，补齐更多也非性能收益。

验证边界：3个完整模块版本只compile，未导入verl、构造DataProto、执行Ray/TQ、位置ID/多模态、Naive/DisRM、precomputed/异常或原pytest。作者12项与相邻53项、另13项fixture失败不算本项目结果；本机库版本也不同于作者锁定环境。attention mask与训练response_mask用途分开，工具观察不因训练mask=0自动在评分时消失；本机只覆盖表中纯文本。没有GPU/NPU新问题，不另排M5硬件队列，不用新增CPU替身冒充真机进展。

SHA256：base agent_loop.py 03a71e04a5303115afda35bb98d12f6e0545877a6e47508bca91189eea6a8f6b；head agent_loop.py ca00c47a083a924f60d931e79222e801997beb0563490967d3a802e110dac538；head dapo.py 6fdc9ce3bc2ac956fe111ef5600f175c4c4c161dce1ea836c1c0385b6080feed。

过程中的路径检查先在错误cwd寻找项目笔记，纠正后读取原专题；尝试查看不存在diary/index.md返回错误，日期索引实际由日志工具维护diary/readme.md，不按失败推断缺日志。write-page技能用于沿用原奖励专题、区分局部几何与完整框架验证；实际时间由工具跨日生成，不回填昨日。按规则维护当日回看/WORK/索引后检查并推送自有项目，无上游评论/PR/发布或M5专项改动。

接续：本题收束；下轮转独立UniRL/verl问题或真正新变化，不堆padding例/假manager，不把局部长度控制外推训练质量、性能或显存峰值。推送时遇到M5跨日提交2132656，正常合并双方WORK和新建日期日志，按00:09/00:10顺序保留全文，不强推；未执行其下载/设备操作。73份文档抬头、22项网页测试和diff检查通过。

00:39 — 区分教师指纹一致性与控制器失败传播

"""Only original path assignments and real pytest fixtures, not verl engines."""
import ast
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import pytest
import yaml

REPO = Path(__file__).parent / "verl-7913"
BASE = "3c6d9b43b67c74ec343d77874cd8fa6e841523da"
HEAD = "37f7d0c6b5389bcfd06a455188359c092194ae80"


def source(revision, name):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "show", f"{revision}:{name}"], cwd=REPO, text=True
    )


def path_assignment(revision):
    text = source(revision, "tests/models/test_engine.py")
    compile(text, "test_engine.py", "exec")  # Syntax only: no module execution.
    function = next(node for node in ast.parse(text).body
                    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "test_critic_engine")
    assignment = next(node for node in function.body
                      if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
                      and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "value_model_path"
                              for target in node.targets))
    return compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[assignment], type_ignores=[])),
                   f"{revision}:value_model_path", "exec")


ASSIGNMENTS = {revision: path_assignment(revision) for revision in (BASE, HEAD)}
workflow = yaml.safe_load(source(HEAD, ".github/workflows/model_ascend.yml"))
assert workflow["env"]["MEGATRON_CONFIG_LOCK_DIR"] == "/root/.cache/temp/megatron-config-locks"
steps = workflow["jobs"]["model_rmpad_fsdp2_unstable_ascend"]["steps"]
assert [step["name"] for step in steps if "PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT" in step.get("env", {})] == [
    "Running model_engine_ascend"
]
assert next(step for step in steps if step.get("name") == "Running model_engine_ascend")[
    "env"]["PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT"] == "/root/.cache/temp"


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def layout(tmp_path_factory):
    root = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("cache-layout")
    cache, home = root / "model-cache", root / "home"
    cache.mkdir()
    home.mkdir()
    (home / "models").symlink_to(cache, target_is_directory=True)
    state = {"home": home, "cache": cache, "old": set(), "new": set()}
    yield state
    assert len(state["old"]) == 1
    assert len(state["new"]) == 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize("strategy", ["fsdp", "fsdp2"])
def test_original_path_assignments(strategy, tmp_path, monkeypatch, layout):
    monkeypatch.setenv("HOME", str(layout["home"]))
    paths = {}
    for revision, code in ASSIGNMENTS.items():
        scope = {"os": os, "tmp_path": tmp_path}
        exec(code, scope)
        paths[revision] = Path(scope["value_model_path"])
    old, new = paths[BASE], paths[HEAD]
    assert old.resolve() == layout["cache"] / "test_model"
    assert new.is_relative_to(Path(os.environ["PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT"]).resolve())
    assert not new.is_relative_to(layout["cache"])
    assert new not in layout["new"]
    new.mkdir()
    (new / "marker.txt").write_text(strategy)
    assert (new / "marker.txt").read_text() == strategy
    assert list(layout["cache"].iterdir()) == []
    layout["old"].add(old.resolve())
    layout["new"].add(new)
    print(f"{strategy}: old={old.resolve()}, new={new}")

"""Run original test coroutines with original class bodies, without framework imports."""
import ast
import asyncio
import __future__
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Any, Optional

import numpy as np
from pydantic import BaseModel
import pytest

REPO = Path(__file__).parent / "verl-7913"
BASE = "3c6d9b43b67c74ec343d77874cd8fa6e841523da"
HEAD = "cd99daf82e4ce52afd1fe02eb47956f0cb381626"
TEST = "tests/workers/rollout/test_llm_server_min_tokens_on_cpu.py"


def parsed(revision, path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{revision}:{path}"], cwd=REPO, text=True)
    compile(text, path, "exec")  # Full-file syntax only.
    return ast.parse(text)


def execute(nodes, namespace):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]))
    exec(compile(tree, "original-git-objects", "exec", flags=__future__.annotations.compiler_flag), namespace)


for revision in (BASE, HEAD):
    module = ModuleType("isolated_llm_server")
    scope = module.__dict__
    scope.update(asyncio=asyncio, np=np, BaseModel=BaseModel, Any=Any, Optional=Optional)
    for path, names in (
        ("verl/workers/rollout/replica.py", {"TokenOutput"}),
        ("verl/utils/tokenizer/tokenizer.py", {"normalize_token_ids"}),
        ("verl/workers/rollout/llm_server.py", {"LLMServerClient", "FullyAsyncLLMServerClient"}),
    ):
        nodes = [node for node in parsed(revision, path).body if getattr(node, "name", None) in names]
        for node in nodes:
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                for member in node.body:
                    if isinstance(member, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                        member.decorator_list = []  # Omit tracing only, not method bodies.
        execute(nodes, scope)
    scope["TokenOutput"].model_rebuild(_types_namespace=scope)
    tests = {"llm_server": module, "FullyAsyncLLMServerClient": scope["FullyAsyncLLMServerClient"],
             "TokenOutput": scope["TokenOutput"]}
    execute([node for node in parsed(HEAD, TEST).body
             if not (isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and (node.module or "").startswith("verl"))], tests)
    cases = [
        ("test_resume_shrinks_min_tokens_with_budget", ("min_tokens", "max_tokens")),
        ("test_resume_shrinks_min_tokens_with_budget", ("min_new_tokens", "max_new_tokens")),
        ("test_resume_past_min_tokens_floors_at_zero", ()),
        ("test_without_min_tokens_adds_none", ()),
    ]
    passed = 0
    for name, args in cases:
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
            try:
                asyncio.run(tests[name](patch, *args))
            except AssertionError as error:
                assert revision == BASE and name != "test_without_min_tokens_adds_none"
                trace = error.__traceback__
                while trace.tb_next:
                    trace = trace.tb_next
                print(revision[:8], name, args, "expected assertion", trace.tb_frame.f_locals.get("seen"))
            else:
                passed += 1
                print(revision[:8], name, args, "PASS")
    assert passed == (1 if revision == BASE else 4)
    print(revision[:8], "original coroutine cases passed:", passed, "/ 4")

"""Real local file IO through original store modules; no encoder/framework startup."""
import ast
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import patch

import torch
import safetensors

REPO = Path(__file__).parent / "unirl-readonly"
for name in ("unirl", "unirl.config", "unirl.utils", "unirl.models",
             "unirl.models.minimax_h3", "unirl.models.minimax_h3.vendor"):
    module = ModuleType(name)
    module.__path__ = []
    sys.modules[name] = module
tree = ast.parse((REPO / "unirl/models/minimax_h3/vendor/packing.py").read_text())
node = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
            and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "MINIMAX_H3_TEXT_ENCODER_LAYER" for t in n.targets))
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), "original-layer-constant", "exec"),
     sys.modules["unirl.models.minimax_h3.vendor"].__dict__)


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, REPO / path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


load("unirl.config.require", "unirl/config/require.py")
load("unirl.utils.dtypes", "unirl/utils/dtypes.py")
store = load("unirl.models.minimax_h3.offline_text_embed", "unirl/models/minimax_h3/offline_text_embed.py")


def writer(path, **extra):
    options = dict(model_checkpoint="fixture-model-A", dtype="bfloat16", shard_size=2,
                   resume=False, force_overwrite=False)
    options.update(extra)
    return store.OfflineTextEmbedWriter(str(path), **options)


def rejects(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError as error:
        return str(error)
    raise AssertionError("Expected ValueError")


result = {"torch": torch.__version__, "safetensors": safetensors.__version__}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="unirl-offline-store-") as temp:
    root = Path(temp)
    cache = root / "cache"
    tensors = {"prompt": torch.ones((1, 5120), dtype=torch.bfloat16),
               " prompt ": torch.full((2, 5120), 2, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
               "third": torch.full((3, 5120), 3, dtype=torch.bfloat16)}
    out = writer(cache)
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        out.add(prompt, tensor)
    out.close()
    assert len({store.compute_prompt_key(p) for p in tensors}) == 3
    reader = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache))
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        assert torch.equal(reader.get(prompt), tensor)
    reader.verify_coverage_or_raise(list(tensors), context="fixture")
    result["round_trip"] = {"prompts": 3, "shards": 2, "exact_whitespace_keys": True}
    for changed in (dict(model_checkpoint="fixture-model-B"), dict(dtype="float32")):
        rejects(lambda: writer(cache, resume=True, **changed))
    result["resume_metadata_rejections"] = 2
    index_path = cache / "index.json"
    original = index_path.read_bytes()
    index = json.loads(original)
    altered = {**index, "model_checkpoint": "fixture-model-B", "dtype": "float32"}
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(altered))
    assert store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache)).get("prompt").dtype == torch.bfloat16
    index_path.write_bytes(original)
    result["reader_metadata_is_not_runtime_identity_check"] = True
    broken = root / "missing-shards"
    broken.mkdir()
    (broken / "index.json").write_bytes(original)
    broken_reader = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(broken))
    broken_reader.verify_coverage_or_raise(list(tensors), context="fixture-missing-shards")
    rejects(lambda: broken_reader.get("prompt"))
    result["coverage_passes_before_missing_shard_get_fails"] = True
    resumed = writer(cache, resume=True, shard_size=1)
    with patch.object(store.os, "replace", side_effect=OSError("injected publication failure")):
        try:
            resumed.add("fourth", torch.ones((1, 5120), dtype=torch.bfloat16))
        except OSError as error:
            assert str(error) == "injected publication failure"
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected injected publication failure")
    assert index_path.read_bytes() == original
    assert (cache / "embeddings_00002.safetensors").exists()
    assert (cache / "index.json.tmp").exists()
    retry = writer(cache, resume=True, shard_size=1)
    assert store.compute_prompt_key("fourth") not in retry.entries and len(retry.entries) == 3
    retry.add("fourth", torch.full((1, 5120), 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
    retry.close()
    fresh = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache))
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        assert torch.equal(fresh.get(prompt), tensor)
    assert torch.equal(fresh.get("fourth"), torch.full((1, 5120), 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
    result["injected_replace_failure"] = "old index unchanged; orphan overwritten on fresh resume; 4 prompts readable"
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

"""Original judge method with real requests.Response fixtures; no HTTP traffic."""
import ast
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import re
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

import requests

REPO = Path(__file__).parent / "unirl-readonly"
source = (REPO / "unirl/reward/local/llm_judge.py").read_text()
compile(source, "llm_judge.py", "exec")
tree = ast.parse(source)
selected = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
            and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in
                    {"_DEFAULT_JUDGE_PROMPT", "_INCORRECT_RE", "_CORRECT_RE"}
                    for target in node.targets)]
cls = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
           and node.name == "LLMJudgeRewardScorer")
method = next(node for node in cls.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_judge_one")
scope = {"re": re, "requests": requests, "logger": logging.getLogger("judge-protocol-control")}
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=selected + [method], type_ignores=[])),
             "original-judge-method", "exec"), scope)
scope["logger"].disabled = True
spec = SimpleNamespace(prompt_template=scope["_DEFAULT_JUDGE_PROMPT"], max_prediction_chars=4000,
                       max_tokens=512, max_retries=3, timeout=0.1)
scorer = SimpleNamespace(_spec=spec, _endpoint="blocked-fixture-only", _judge_model="fixture", _api_key="")
cases = [
    ("positive", 200, {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "correct"}}]}, 1.0, 1),
    ("negative", 200, {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "incorrect"}}]}, 0.0, 1),
    ("negation_not_adjacent", 200,
     {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "This is not the correct answer."}}]}, 1.0, 1),
    ("unrecognized", 200, {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "I cannot judge."}}]}, 0.0, 1),
    ("earlier_negative_later_positive", 200,
     {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "At first I thought incorrect. Final verdict: correct."}}]}, 0.0, 1),
    ("empty_choices", 200, {"choices": []}, 0.0, 3),
    ("http_503", 503, {"error": "fixture-unavailable"}, 0.0, 3),
]
results = []
for name, status, payload, expected, expected_calls in cases:
    response = requests.Response()
    response.status_code = status
    response._content = json.dumps(payload).encode()
    response.url = "blocked-fixture-only"
    with patch.object(requests, "post", return_value=response) as post:
        score = scope["_judge_one"](scorer, "question", "prediction", "answer")
        assert score == expected and post.call_count == expected_calls
        for call in post.call_args_list:
            assert call.args == ("blocked-fixture-only",)
            assert call.kwargs["timeout"] == 0.1

"""Isolate the exact upstream guard; fixtures are not a TrainStack run."""
import ast
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS

REPO = sys.argv[1]
PATH = "unirl/train/stack/single.py"
REVS = ("784893d10c01ab21fdf2e33fbd7cec18123bf80f", "471690694c51f3070e012276429585fcae877a4e")

@dataclasses.dataclass
class Result:
    has_backward: bool
    micros: list
    metrics: dict

def micro(count, metrics, backward=True):
    return NS(num_steps_or_tokens=count, metrics=metrics, has_backward=backward)

for rev in REVS:
    source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{rev}:{PATH}"])
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "TrainStack")
    method = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_guard_first_update_ratio")
    module = ast.Module(body=[ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0), method], type_ignores=[])
    warnings = []
    scope = {"replace": dataclasses.replace, "logger": NS(warning=lambda *args: warnings.append(args))}
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module), PATH, "exec"), scope)
    guard = scope[method.name]
    cases = [
        ("empty", [micro(0, {})], True, 0.1, 0.0, 0),
        ("mixed", [micro(0, {}), micro(4, {"ratio_min": 0.8, "ratio_max": 1.1})], True, 0.1, 0.2, 1),
        ("valid", [micro(4, {"ratio_min": 0.8, "ratio_max": 1.1})], True, 0.1, 0.2, 1),
        ("disabled", [micro(0, {})], True, None, None, 0),
        ("no_backward", [micro(0, {}, False)], False, 0.1, None, 0),
        ("ignored_non_backward", [micro(0, {}, False), micro(2, {"ratio_min": 1.0, "ratio_max": 1.0})], True, 0.1, 0.0, 0),
    ]
    print(rev, "source_sha256", hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest())
    for name, micros, backward, tolerance, expected, warning_count in cases:
        warnings.clear()
        result = Result(backward, micros, {"existing": 7})
        try:
            out = guard(NS(first_update_ratio_tol=tolerance), result)
        except KeyError as exc:
            assert rev == REVS[0] and name in ("empty", "mixed") and exc.args == ("ratio_min",)
            print(name, "KeyError:ratio_min")
            continue
        assert out.metrics["existing"] == 7
        assert result.metrics == {"existing": 7}
        if expected is None:
            assert out is result
        else:
            assert abs(out.metrics["first_update_ratio_dev"] - expected) < 1e-12
        assert len(warnings) == warning_count
        print(name, "PASS", out.metrics, "warnings", len(warnings))

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", REPO, *args], env=ENV)

paths = set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", HEAD).decode().splitlines())

class Originals(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.Loader):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != "unirl" and not fullname.startswith("unirl."):
            return None
        stem = fullname.replace(".", "/")
        file = stem + "/__init__.py" if stem + "/__init__.py" in paths else stem + ".py"
        if file not in paths:
            return None
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=file.endswith("/__init__.py"))
        spec.loader_state = file
        return spec

    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None

    def exec_module(self, module):
        if module.__name__ == "unirl.distributed.tensor":
            # Skip only aggregate imports, especially Ray worker_local; leaf modules remain original.
            return
        file = module.__spec__.loader_state
        exec(compile(git("show", HEAD + ":" + file), file, "exec"), module.__dict__)

"""Native spawned CPU pipe and original runtime helpers, not the vLLM engine lifecycle."""
import hashlib
import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import subprocess
import sys

HEAD = "6fd82cba13f52f394747832344039408699ea378"

def source(repo, path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", repo, "show", f"{HEAD}:{path}"],
                                   env=dict(os.environ, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH="1"))

def worker(conn, repo, previous, count):
    namespace = {"__name__": "original_runtime_helpers"}
    exec(compile(source(repo, "unirl/rollout/engine/vllm/runtime.py"), "runtime.py", "exec"), namespace)
    try:
        for _ in range(count):
            try:
                request = namespace["recv_request"](conn, last_request_id=previous)
            except namespace["ProtocolError"] as error:
                # Classification reply belongs to this harness, not runtime error policy.
                conn.send({"caught": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                return
            previous = request["request_id"]
            namespace["send_response"](conn, request, ok=True, result={"echo": request})
    finally:
        conn.close()

def exchange(repo, messages, previous=0):
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    parent, child = ctx.Pipe(duplex=True)
    process = ctx.Process(target=worker, args=(child, repo, previous, len(messages)))
    process.start()
    child.close()
    responses = []
    try:
        for message in messages:
            parent.send(message)
            assert parent.poll(5), "helper child did not reply"
            responses.append(parent.recv())
        process.join(5)
        assert process.exitcode == 0, process.exitcode
    finally:
        parent.close()
        if process.is_alive():
            process.terminate()
            process.join(5)
    return responses

def main(repo):
    for path in ["unirl/rollout/engine/vllm/runtime.py", "unirl/rollout/engine/vllm/engine.py"]:
        print(path, hashlib.sha256(source(repo, path)).hexdigest())
    messages = [{"request_id": 1, "command": "health"},
                {"request_id": 2, "command": "health", "protocol_version": 999}]
    replies = exchange(repo, messages)
    for message, reply in zip(messages, replies):
        assert reply == {"request_id": message["request_id"], "command": "health",
                         "ok": True, "result": {"echo": message}}
        assert "protocol_version" not in reply
    print("PASS consecutive 1/2: extra version ignored by envelope, absent from response")
    cases = [("non_mapping", [], 0, "mapping"),
             ("duplicate", {"request_id": 1, "command": "health"}, 1, "monotonic"),
             ("gap", {"request_id": 3, "command": "health"}, 1, "monotonic"),
             ("bool_id", {"request_id": True, "command": "health"}, 0, "monotonic"),
             ("empty_command", {"request_id": 1, "command": ""}, 0, "command"),
             ("non_string_command", {"request_id": 1, "command": 7}, 0, "command")]
    for label, message, previous, fragment in cases:
        reply, = exchange(repo, [message], previous)
        assert reply["caught"] == "ProtocolError" and fragment in reply["message"]
        print("PASS rejected", label)
    unknown = {"request_id": 1, "command": "not-a-real-command"}
    reply, = exchange(repo, [unknown])
    assert reply["command"] == unknown["command"] and reply["ok"] is True
    print("PASS nonempty unknown command accepted by envelope only; dispatch not executed")
    assert "torch" not in sys.modules and "vllm" not in sys.modules and "ray" not in sys.modules
    print("NOT RUN: engine constructor/request/state/disposal, command dispatch, model, vLLM/Ray/GPU")

import sys

REPO = sys.argv[1]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", REPO, *args], env=dict(os.environ, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH="1"))

paths = set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", HEAD).decode().splitlines())

class Originals(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.Loader):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != "unirl" and not fullname.startswith("unirl."):
            return None
        stem = fullname.replace(".", "/")
        path = stem + "/__init__.py" if stem + "/__init__.py" in paths else stem + ".py"
        if path not in paths:
            return None
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=path.endswith("/__init__.py"))
        spec.loader_state = path
        return spec

    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None

    def exec_module(self, module):
        if module.__name__ == "unirl.distributed.tensor":
            return  # Skip aggregate imports only, especially Ray worker_local.
        path = module.__spec__.loader_state
        raw = git("show", HEAD + ":" + path)
        exec(compile(raw, HEAD + ":" + path, "exec"), module.__dict__)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(1, 2, 12, dtype=torch.float64, device='cpu').reshape(4, 3))

class Originals(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.Loader):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != 'unirl' and not fullname.startswith('unirl.'):
            return None
        stem = fullname.replace('.', '/')
        path = stem + '/__init__.py' if stem + '/__init__.py' in paths else stem + '.py'
        if path not in paths:
            return None
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=path.endswith('/__init__.py'))
        spec.loader_state = path
        return spec

    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None

    def exec_module(self, module):
        if module.__name__ == 'unirl.distributed.tensor':

            for source in (batch, ref):
                for name in dir(source):
                    if not name.startswith('_'):
                        setattr(module, name, getattr(source, name))
            return
        path = module.__spec__.loader_state
        exec(compile(git('show', HEAD + ':' + path), path, 'exec'), module.__dict__)

class Originals(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.Loader):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != 'unirl' and not fullname.startswith('unirl.'):
            return None
        stem = fullname.replace('.', '/')
        path = stem + '/__init__.py' if stem + '/__init__.py' in paths else stem + '.py'
        if path not in paths:
            return None
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=path.endswith('/__init__.py'))
        spec.loader_state = path
        return spec

    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None

    def exec_module(self, module):
        if module.__name__ == 'unirl.distributed.tensor':
            from unirl.distributed.tensor import batch, ref
            for source in (batch, ref):
                for name in dir(source):
                    if not name.startswith('_'):
                        setattr(module, name, getattr(source, name))
            return
        path = module.__spec__.loader_state
        exec(compile(git('show', HEAD + ':' + path), path, 'exec'), module.__dict__)
